description: An infrared orthophoto displays a mountainous landscape in Kebnekaise, Sweden, featuring prominent white areas representing glaciers and perpetual snow. The surrounding terrain appears in shades of dark reddish-brown, characteristic of bare rock or sparse vegetation in an infrared false-colour composite. Some brighter red patches within the reddish-brown areas may indicate more vigorous vegetation. The rugged topography shows valleys and mountain slopes. The image credit is "Lantmäteriet, Sweden."
